summary: This note describes Family, the ninth studio album by American country singer LeAnn Rimes, released October 9, 2007 by Curb Records in the United States. The album was produced mainly by Dann Huff, with additional production by Tony Brown and a guest vocal appearance by Reba McEntire. The note is a short introductory overview and does not go into track details or reception.
one_line: Family is LeAnn Rimes's ninth studio album, released by Curb Records in October 2007 with production by Dann Huff.
key_facts: Family is the ninth studio album by American country recording artist LeAnn Rimes.
Family was released by Curb Records in the United States.
Family was produced primarily by musician and record producer Dann Huff.
Additional production on Family was done by Tony Brown.
Reba McEntire appears as a guest vocalist on Family.
